title: Men in black at Point Pleasant during Keel's Mothman investigation

tellings.quote: there were also men in black who would all of a sudden like show up outside the uh journalism bureau there

plain: In 1966 and 1967, while the writer John Keel was in Point Pleasant, West Virginia, looking into the Mothman, a winged creature locals said they had seen, men in black would suddenly turn up outside the local newspaper office. Men in black are strange, formally dressed visitors said to appear around UFO witnesses. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells Michels this from Keel's account as he knows it, and if true it would mean someone was watching the investigation.
